_comment: Vulnerability intake for the dashboard. One entry per vulnerability or event. 'tier' is the triage verdict and must be one of dashboard.TIERS. A 'live' or 'archive_only' entry names a published PatchEvent in src/versions.py by 'event'; an 'awaiting_fix' entry may name an unpublished one. Add entries here by hand or from the triage agent; a human reviews every tier change before it is committed.

entries.title: PHP2Shell
entries.signal: PHP version in the X-Powered-By or Server header of one homepage GET
entries.why: The fixed releases (8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27, 8.5.12) change the version string, so a disclosed version ranks against them. Hidden versions and distro backports stay indeterminate.

entries.title: PHP session upload progress
entries.signal: Same PHP version header as PHP2Shell, once a fixed release exists
entries.why: Pre-registered as threshold T2 (analysis plan §5.2). php.net says the fix ships in the next regular release, which is not out yet, so there is nothing to rank against.

entries.title: PHP-CGI argument injection
entries.signal: PHP version header in archived Common Crawl captures
entries.why: A 2024 adoption benchmark read from the archive only. Exposure needed Windows PHP-CGI, which a header cannot show, so it measures how fast sites adopt a release rather than how exposed they were.

entries.title: TianoCore EDK II firmware flaw
entries.component: UEFI firmware built on EDK II (AMI, Insyde, Phoenix, Project Mu)
entries.why: Firmware does not reveal its version to a web request. Reading it needs local access (dmidecode, fwupd) or a management interface (Redfish, IPMI), both outside a passive design. CVE ID not yet recorded here.
sources: Ars Technica report shared 2026-10-28 (URL not recorded)
